{{Top}}
'''Secretary droids''' or '''receptionist droids''' were [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that performed secretarial duties. The [[CZ-series secretary/comm droid|CZ-series communications/business droid]] was an example of this type of droid. [[D-3P-O2]] was a secretary droid that worked for the [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adept]] [[Vost Tyne]].
